items.title: Zscaler stock soars on reports that CrowdStrike is eyeing a possible buyout
items.summary: Zscaler (ZS) shares are surging in Friday's after-hours trading following Bloomberg reporting that CrowdStrike (CRWD) is in talks to buy the cybersecurity firm.

items.title: CrowdStrike, Zscaler Merger Would Create Cybersecurity Giant
items.summary: CrowdStrike stock fell and Zscaler stock popped amid a report the companies are in merger talks. A deal would create a cybersecurity giant.

items.title: Zscaler Stock Soars 18% On CrowdStrike Takeover Report. $32 Billion Cybersecurity Deal In Focus.
items.summary: Zscaler shares jumped about 18% after a report that CrowdStrike was discussing a takeover of the cybersecurity company, valued at roughly $32 billion.

items.title: ZS Stock Soars After-Hours While CRWD Slips On Reported $265B Takeover Talks
items.summary: CrowdStrike is in talks to buy Zscaler, according to people familiar with the matter cited by Bloomberg.

items.title: CrowdStrike Said in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
items.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would be among the largest-ever in the cybersecurity sector. Zscaler, which had a market value of $32 billion at the end of regular trading Friday, rose about 16% after the close. The two companies are discussing a potential combination that could come together soon, the people said, asking not to be identified because the information is confidential. Bloomberg News Deals Reporter Ryan Gould reports on the deal.

items.title: CrowdStrike weighs Zscaler buyout in potential cybersecurity mega-deal - Bloomberg
items.summary: Investing.com -- CrowdStrike Holdings Inc (NASDAQ:CRWD) is in discussions to acquire Zscaler Inc (NASDAQ:ZS), according to a Friday report from Bloomberg that cites people familiar with the matter. A potential combination would rank among the largest transactions in cybersecurity history, creating an enterprise with a combined market value of roughly $265 billion.

items.title: CrowdStrike Is in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
items.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would be among the largest-ever in the cybersecurity sector and create a company with a combined market value of about $265 billion.
